# Aumrti — Module Catalogue

**67 module tiles, 61 billable module keys.** Both numbers are correct; they
answer different questions. A *tile* is something a user clicks on the `/modules` grid. A *key* is
what a subscription plan grants and what `ModuleGate` enforces. Several tiles are views onto one
key — the three `/accounts/*` tiles all bill as `accounts` — so tiles outnumber keys by design.

**When a buyer asks "how many modules do I get", the honest answer is 61.**

Rows marked ⁺ share their billable key with another tile in the same category. Generated from
[`src/lib/modules.ts`](../../src/lib/modules.ts) and
[`src/lib/moduleKeys.ts`](../../src/lib/moduleKeys.ts) on 2026-09-03.

> There is **no `M1..M39` numbering** in this product. Those identifiers appear only as prose in
> `.agents/agents.md` and must not be used in customer-facing material.

## Billable keys with no tile on the grid

These are gated and billable but reached from inside another module or from the sidebar rather
than the `/modules` launcher:

- `ai_suite`
- `assets`

`ai_suite` is the master switch for the AI feature set. It is deliberately routeless: it gates
features inside other modules rather than a screen of its own, and it defaults **on**.

## Which plan includes which module

The authoritative mapping is the `plan_features` table, which a platform administrator edits live
in `/platform → Plans` — so a module's tier can change without a deploy and this file cannot
assert it. The published tier positioning on [`/pricing`](../../src/pages/PricingPage.tsx) is:

| Tier | Positioning |
|---|---|
| **Clinic & Day Care** | OPD, day care, billing, retail pharmacy, laboratory, patient portal |
| **Starter** | Everything in Clinic, plus IPD/wards, nursing, radiology, inpatient pharmacy, HR, inventory, day closure |
| **Professional** | Everything in Starter, plus OT, emergency, blood bank, CSSD, insurance/TPA, PMJAY, ABDM, the NABH engine and the full AI suite |
| **Enterprise** | Everything in Professional, plus SLA-backed support, a dedicated success manager, custom integrations and migration assistance |

See [PRICING_NARRATIVE.md](../gtm/PRICING_NARRATIVE.md) for how to explain these to a buyer, and
[FACT_BASE.md](FACT_BASE.md) for the counts.
